title: Chat panel · round 1
intro: Claude Design, 22 Nov. The panel opens on a session picker every time, the same tree in Code and Wiki. Same moment on every picker: review main → feat/send-review is current, 6 sessions open. The empty state is shared: the empty node with “New session for this review” as primary, ↩ takes it.

A · One list (designer's pick): the suggestion is the first, focused row, its reason on a second line (“opened this review · 4m”); a filter field appears above 9 sessions. Only existing nodes plus two props (row caption, initial focus).
B · Suggestion card: the suggestion is a card with a primary Continue ↩ button; the other sessions are a quiet list below; 20+ get a “Show 14 more” row.
C · Grouped by nearness: sections for this review, this worktree and other worktrees; New session sits inside the group it would join; other worktrees fold into one row each with a count.

Also on the boards: chat header H1 back button ⌘[ + context chips in the composer (pick), H2 title opens the picker, H3 “Sessions / title” breadcrumb. Wiki W1 chat takes the margin column's place (pick), W2 right of the margin, W3 Outline | Chat tabs. Key K1 (pick): ⌘B toggles the chat in Code and Wiki, ⌃⌘S the sidebar everywhere; in Wiki ⌘B changes meaning. iPad in scope: P1 400 pt side panel in landscape (list column hides), P2 sheet with medium/large detents in portrait and compact.
